name: famcsSkedBot
description: Monorepo for Telegram bot, Cloudflare Workers API, and frontend Mini App

scripts.install:all: cd pkgs/telegram-bot && npm install && cd ../worker-api && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:frontend: cd pkgs/frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:frontend
